description: Add ntfy (https://ntfy.sh) as a Vrooli resource for push notification delivery. Docker container deployment with upstream-base-url configured to https://ntfy.sh for iOS APNs relay (only content-free wake-up signals go through ntfy.sh cloud; actual message content stays on local server). Register in .vrooli/service.json resource registry. Configure authentication, topic namespacing, and access control. Test end-to-end: server sends notification -> ntfy relays APNs wake -> iOS ntfy app fetches message from local server. Document known iOS delivery caveats and configuration requirements.
name: ntfy-vrooli-resource
title: Set Up ntfy As A Vrooli Resource
